description: Optimized SI kernels phi_P^* (Section 4.5): for each order P and tolerance eps, the admissible kernel phi = B_2 * g that meets eps on the coarsest grid, h = h_0/s*, h_0 = pi r_c/c_s, in the relative AD aliasing error of the band |xi| <= c_s/r_c (limit of large boxes), with the C^2 Coulomb split and the optimal influence function.
representation: g(t) = sum_k legendre_coefficients[k] P_k(t/a) for |t| <= a = (P - 2)/2, g = 0 beyond; phi = B_2 * g, B_2(t) = max(1 - |t|, 0); phi is supported on [-P/2, P/2], in grid units.
fields: c_s: splitting bandwidth (ESP's rule); s_star: coarsest grid ratio; h_over_rc: largest grid spacing, pi/(c_s s*); error: relative AD aliasing error on that grid; c_w: bandwidth of the PSWF basis of g; comparison: coarsest ratios of B_P (large boxes) and of the psi_0 kernel (box of side 10 r_c), None if above 4
